Yes, you can waive the hold by replying to the weather hold email. Be aware that if you do, the Plant Care Guarantee still applies, but cold or heat damage in transit isn't covered, and DOA claims for that damage won't be accepted.

I can't promise Friday delivery. It depends on when the plant ships and your shipping zone and method. Standard takes 2-3 business days in Zone 1, 3-5 in Zone 2 and 5-8 in Zone 3. Express is next business day in Zone 1, 2 business days in Zone 2, and not available in Zone 3. If you share your zone and shipping method, I can tell you whether Friday looks realistic.
